title: On release day an open work order keeps its one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Before the release was installed, work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} was open (not invoiced) with {Sales-rep-A} as its sales representative.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-39001.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • The browser window is a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, and the design pictures "card-00-b-wo-rest2.png" (board 1.0) and "card-01-b-wo-open.png" (board 1.1) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card.
  2. Invoice {Work-order-1}.
  3. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  4. Set the date range to today.
  5. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  6. Expand {Sales-rep-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-A}; the card is not split and reads as before.
  • Step 2: the invoice is created.
  • Step 3: the Sales By Representative report opens.
  • Step 4: the report shows today's date range.
  • Step 5: a Sales Type column shows.
  • Step 6: the whole invoice is credited to {Sales-rep-A} as one "Labor, Parts" row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Release day: “Every open work order keeps its one sales representative on both sides and is not split, so its card reads as before.”
  • S5-R10: “When one person, or Unassigned, holds both the Labor and the Parts side of a work order and the Sales Type filter includes both, the two show as one row whose Sales Type reads "Labor, Parts" and whose figures are the sum of both sides.”
  • Feature Overview: “A shop that never adds a field sees one Sales Representative field, as today. The one person is credited with the whole invoice.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
